view_title: TRUSS T1, TRUSS T2, TRUSS T3, TRUSS T4
views: view4: TRUSS T2 — all four are truss elevations of the same kind, kept in one section file (one element per truss)
warnings: Every truss has two callouts: 'rectangular tube Ø-100x50x1.8 mm.' with two arrows on the top and bottom chords, and 'rectangular tube Ø-75x38x1.7 mm.' on a vertical. Chords recorded in steel_section, verticals in web_steel_section. The designation is kept as printed ('rectangular tube'); the slashed-rectangle symbol in the callout is in printed_as.

TRUSS T2 and TRUSS T3 both print 'ระดับหลังคา +3.67' at their top-chord line, but T3 (along C, the high side of the mono-pitch roof) is drawn 0.787 deep against T2's 0.418 and T1 rises from A toward C; both top chords cannot sit at +3.67 if the bottom chords share the อะเส level (+3.30). Kept as printed on each detail and T3 flagged — the drawing does not say which reading is meant.

Panel chains (1.000 ticks) carry no grid bubbles; they are placed on the grid by their supports (T-labels at the posts) and recorded in the grid master's dimension_chains. Top-chord overhangs are not dimensioned on these elevations; the roof plan's 1.00 roof-edge ticks are used for the overhang segments in the roof frame plan file.
